notes: This contract records provider- and FOM-independent API checks for standard RTI ambassador construction. The C++ test verifies the official RTIambassadorFactory can create multiple RTIambassador objects; the Java test verifies the discovered standard RtiFactory can do the same. Neither asserts provider-specific configuration, endpoint, FOM, or service behavior.

api_surfaces.source: adapter-supplied official IEEE 1516.1-2025 Java API JAR
